tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Unchanged from the current app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and inputs on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings: 15.9:1 on surface, 16.8:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata: 6.1:1 on surface, 6.5:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and upcoming seam stitches: 3.1:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Shweshwe indigo. Actions, links, the active tab, progress and focus rings. White text on it 10:1; as text on surface 9.5:1. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: indigo-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of indigo fills. White text on it 12.6:1.

tokens.name: indigo-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active filters and info backgrounds. Indigo text on it 8.4:1.

tokens.name: protea
tokens.usage: Brand moments only: the day-90 milestone, illustration, the eventual mark. Never an action or a status; never text under 24px (3.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: protea-tint
tokens.usage: Avatar and milestone backgrounds.

tokens.name: protea-ink
tokens.usage: Text on protea-tint, such as avatar initials: 8.0:1.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Check-in read: on track. Status only, always with its word. 5.0:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: status-watch
tokens.usage: Check-in read: watch. Status only, always with its word. 3.7:1 on surface-raised, so dots and stitches, never text.

tokens.name: status-alert
tokens.usage: Check-in read: needs attention. Status only, always with its word. 6.6:1 on surface-raised.

groups.name: Schibsted Grotesk
groups.note: Everything functional: names, headings, numbers and UI. Hosted on Google Fonts at 400, 500 and 600. Figures always lining; never tabular, which widens commas and full stops in this face.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page headline, once per page.

styles.name: person-name
styles.usage: Candidate and placement names. Wraps to two lines; never truncates.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We check in with you and your hire twice a week for the first fortnight, then weekly.
styles.usage: Running text, 65 characters a line at most.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels and navigation. Sentence case, no tracking.

groups.name: Newsreader
groups.note: One job only: a trainer's or check-in words, always attributed. Hosted on Google Fonts, italic 400.

styles.name: attestation
styles.sample: Arrives early, sets up without being asked, and stays calm when the queue is out the door.
styles.usage: Trainer attestations and quoted check-in notes. Never headings or decoration.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a component: icon to label, between early seam stitches.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Seam stitches, tags and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.
